verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser is an immigration law firm, so publishing pricing that separates its own fees from USCIS filing and premium processing fees is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence pack shows any pricing page or fee breakdown. The cited items cover its Visalaw AI product, its startup and O-1 practice areas, and I-9 compliance, none of which document legal fees or government fees.
